name: Tideglass
apple_promotional_text: Build a luminous harbor, chart a stronger fleet, and uncover the stories carried by the tide. A thoughtful idle game with room to step away.
google_short_description: Restore a harbor of light in a thoughtful idle game of fleets and discovery
description:
Bring a quiet harbor back to life, one light at a time.

Start with a single Spark Skiff. Grow five kinds of producers, find the connections between them, and turn your first small income into a fleet that works while you are away. Rechart when you are ready to rebuild with permanent Charts and new possibilities.

A HARBOR WITH A STORY
Restore six chapters of the harbor and uncover eighteen archive entries. Take on twelve challenge dossiers with separate rules, and collect decorations that make the shoreline your own.

YOUR OWN RHYTHM
Choose purchases yourself or unlock automation plans. Complete short calibrations, collect Surveys, and work through daily contracts with a seven-day backlog. Offline earnings continue at full rate for the first 24 hours, then at a quarter rate for the next 48 hours.

A SEPARATE SEASONAL FLEET
Explore a 28-day season with its own production rules. Main-harbor wealth and purchased appearances do not increase the seasonal fleet's power. Earn cosmetic and story rewards through a 30-level pass.

ROOM TO STEP AWAY
Use larger text, reduced motion, independent music and sound controls, and optional reminders. Start locally without an account. Optional cloud recovery is available when you choose to link an account.

OPTIONAL SUPPORT
Cosmetic purchases and the premium pass change appearances, not production. Optional rewarded ads share the same daily allowance and rewards as free crew briefings. There are no forced ads, paid currency packs or paid production multipliers.

The main game is playable offline. Paid appearances may require a fresh online ownership check after time offline or an app restart. Account recovery, purchase verification, rewarded ads and soundtrack downloads require an internet connection. English language.

reviewer_notes.guest_entry: Launch the submitted app and enter the harbor without creating an account. First-purchase, return, Rechart and recovery explanations are accessible from gameplay/settings.
reviewer_notes.commerce: Commerce must be enabled only with configured native products, the correct service origin and pinned public signing keys. Use actual store sandbox accounts for review. No test credential or synthetic receipt belongs in this listing.
reviewer_notes.account: Optional account creation follows cloud consent. A recovery code is presented once and must be acknowledged. Account export/deletion and privacy controls are in Account and services.
reviewer_notes.equal_free_route: Crew support offers a free briefing using the same six daily slots and same reward rules as an optional verified ad. Ad refusal or no-fill does not remove the free route.
reviewer_notes.seeded_capture_notice_internal: Screenshots may use reproducible legitimately reachable setup states; capture manifests must identify them. Do not imply sped-up test time is normal pacing.
